subject: IOY / IONITY Direct exact station and connector tariff reuse

decision.reason: The France IONITY Direct method was successfully reused on Italy. Exact live prices are available for the published IONITY-operated connector flow, but the current canonical PUN baseline has 322 EVSE while the recoverable 2026-08-30 Italy static inventory has 313 EVSE and only 300 of those map deterministically to current connector numbers. IOY therefore remains partial/fail-closed for the residual canonical perimeter.
decision.tariffChannel: IONITY DIRECT ad-hoc from public IONITY backend; subscriptions and eMSP roaming excluded
decision.mapping: PUN/TCC station coordinates -> live IONITY location UUID within 150 m, then final two digits of IT*IOY EVSE -> exact live connector number

residual.unmatchedStaticLocation: Piacenza, Via Emilia Parmense 151: 6 EVSE absent from the current IONITY location feed
residual.matchedLocationOldConnectorIds: 7 EVSE absent by connector number at Valmontone and Les Iles de Brissogne Sud
residual.canonicalVsStaticDelta: 9 additional EVSE in the 2026-09-20 canonical count are not present in the recoverable 2026-08-30 static inventory and cannot be mapped without a fresher nominative PUN extract
residual.conditionToComplete: Obtain a fresh nominative 322-EVSE PUN inventory and reconcile the 22 residual EVSE against current IONITY UUID/connector numbers; do not infer identity for the 25 API-only connectors without EVSE evidence.
